issues.description: The problem statement requires the Farm to use a List for the aggregation of animals and explicitly instructs to implement it using an ArrayList initialized in the no-argument constructor. However, the solution implementation uses a Set<Animal> (HashSet) for the animals attribute and corresponding getter/setter, which contradicts the specified collection type and initialization approach. This mismatch can confuse students about which collection type to use and about expected ordering/duplication behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent: either update the solution to use List<Animal> and initialize it as new ArrayList<>() in the no-arg constructor (and adjust getter/setter signatures to return/accept List<Animal>), or change the problem statement and instructions to accept a Set-based implementation and explain the behavioral differences. Prefer updating the solution to follow the stated exercise instructions (List/ArrayList) so students can follow the task as described.
